title: Red imported fire ant
summary: Solenopsis invicta is an ant species widely studied for defensive sting behavior, rapid colony recruitment, and ecological impact where established.

title: Solenopsis invicta venom
summary: A biologically active mixture with alkaloid-rich components and protein fractions relevant to allergic responses.

title: Solenopsin A
summary: Featured representative compound. Not claimed as sole mediator of all clinical effects.

title: Solenopsin A mechanism
aliases: Persistent local discomfort in some cases

title: Solenopsin A effects
summary: Direct local tissue effects at sting site.
